name: RuView
description_en: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel of video.
readme_excerpt: π RuView See through walls with WiFi ## Turn ordinary WiFi into a spatial intelligence / sensing system. Detect people, measure breathing and heart rate, track movement, and monitor rooms — through walls, in the dark, with no cameras or wearables. Just physics. Works natively with the four major smart-home ecosystems: Home Assistant via the HA-DISCO MQTT publisher, Apple Home & HomePod as a discoverable HAP-1.1 bridge, Google Home + Amazon Alexa via the same HA bridge or a Matter endpoint.
